chunks: They would like to escape from the Fire, but will never succeed, and their suffering will be constant
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the punishment for those in the Fire who wish to leave?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'idah highlights the finality of divine decree for those who rejected the Imamate and the truth of Ali ibn Abi Talib, illustrating that their desire for escape is futile due to the 'permanent' (muqim) nature of their punishment. It underscores the concept of 'eternal abode' not merely as duration, but as a fixed state resulting from their own choice to remain in disbelief despite clear signs.
